notes: Alipay and WeChat Pay work with foreign cards, and cash is rarely used; the metro is cheap and extensive (3-7 CNY). The maglev takes 8 minutes to Pudong.
Visa: in 2026 many countries get 30 days visa-free (check for Türkiye); set up a VPN for Google and WhatsApp in advance.
October to November is best (18-22°C); winter is damp and cold at 5°C, February is closed for Chinese New Year, April brings cherry blossom.
Xiaolongbao costs 30-50 CNY; go to Yang's for shengjianbao; brunch in the French Concession is 100+.
Museums are free, but you need to reserve online with your passport; buy your Shanghai Tower ticket online.
No tipping; bargaining works in markets, not in shops.

stops.name: The Bund
stops.tips: A row of colonial buildings with Pudong across the river; tai chi practitioners in the morning, no crowds.

stops.name: Nanjing Road East
stops.tips: China's busiest pedestrian street; visit the Shanghai First Food Store.

stops.name: People's Square & Shanghai Museum
stops.tips: Bronze and porcelain collections; free, but you need to reserve with your passport.

stops.name: Yang's Fry Dumplings
stops.tips: Shengjianbao (pan-fried soup dumplings); on Huanghe Road, bite and suck the soup.

stops.name: Bund Night View
stops.tips: Pudong lights 19:00-22:00; a Huangpu River cruise (~120 CNY) is optional.

backups.name: Jia Jia Tang Bao
backups.tips: A xiaolongbao legend; on Huanghe Road, closes early.

backups.name: Huangpu River Cruise
backups.tips: Night river cruise; instead of the Bund.

stops.name: Yu Garden
stops.tips: A classical Ming-dynasty garden; quiet at the 08:30 opening, with a zigzag bridge.

stops.name: Yuyuan Bazaar
stops.tips: A bazaar around the garden; souvenirs and tea.

stops.name: Nanxiang Mantou Dian
stops.tips: The birthplace of xiaolongbao since 1900; upstairs has seating, downstairs has a queue for takeaway.

stops.name: City God Temple
stops.tips: A Taoist temple in the middle of the bazaar.

stops.name: Tianzifang
stops.tips: Studios and cafes in the Shikumen alleys; in the French Concession.

backups.name: Lin Long Fang
backups.tips: Local xiaolongbao; in the French Concession, no tourists.

backups.name: Huxinting Teahouse
backups.tips: A teahouse over the Yu Garden lake.

stops.name: Shanghai Tower Top of Shanghai
stops.tips: 118th floor, 632 m; best on a clear morning, with the world's fastest lift.

stops.name: Lujiazui Pedestrian Bridge
stops.tips: Views of the Oriental Pearl and the towers from the circular bridge.

stops.name: Shanghai Ocean Aquarium
stops.tips: A 155 m underwater tunnel; good with children.

stops.name: Din Tai Fung Pudong
stops.tips: Xiaolongbao and chicken soup; air-conditioned.

stops.name: Century Park
stops.tips: Pudong's huge park; lake and cycling.

backups.name: Shanghai Grandma Pudong
backups.tips: Local Shanghai cuisine; hongshao rou (red-braised pork).

backups.name: Oriental Pearl Tower
backups.tips: A retro pink tower; instead of Shanghai Tower.

stops.name: Wukang Road
stops.tips: A plane-tree-lined boulevard and Wukang Mansion; Art Deco villas and cafes.

stops.name: Propaganda Poster Art Centre
stops.tips: Mao-era posters in an apartment block basement; hidden and fascinating.

stops.name: Fu 1039
stops.tips: Shanghai cuisine in a 1913 villa; drunken chicken and red-braised pork.

stops.name: Xintiandi
stops.tips: Cafes in restored Shikumen houses; the Museum of the First National Congress of the Communist Party is free.

stops.name: Fuxing Park
stops.tips: A French-style park; retirees dancing and playing mahjong.

backups.name: Jesse Restaurant
backups.tips: The old Jesse; hongshao rou (red-braised pork), reservation needed.

backups.name: Shanghai Museum of Art Pudong
backups.tips: A new museum across from the Bund; instead of Xintiandi.

stops.name: Zhujiajiao Fangsheng Bridge
stops.tips: 1 hour on Metro Line 17; a five-arch bridge from 1571, best before the tour buses arrive in the morning.

stops.name: Zhujiajiao Canal Boat Tour
stops.tips: Gondola ride through the canals; 20 minutes.

stops.name: Kezhi Garden
stops.tips: The town's classical garden; entry with a combined ticket.

stops.name: Zhujiajiao Canalside Restaurant
stops.tips: Zongzi (sticky rice dumplings) and pork trotters; riverside tables.

stops.name: Zhujiajiao Bei Dajie
stops.tips: Shops along North Street; roasted chestnuts.

backups.name: Ah Po Cha Lou Zhujiajiao
backups.tips: A teahouse over the canal; dim sum.

backups.name: Qibao Ancient Town
backups.tips: A water town close to the city; a short alternative to Zhujiajiao.

stops.name: Humble Administrator's Garden
stops.tips: 25 minutes by high-speed train from Hongqiao; China's most famous classical garden, a UNESCO site.

stops.name: Suzhou Museum
stops.tips: I.M. Pei's white-and-grey museum; free, reservation required.

stops.name: Pingjiang Road
stops.tips: An old street along the canal; silk shops and teahouses.

stops.name: Pingjiang Road Noodle House
stops.tips: Suzhou sweet noodle soup.

stops.name: Tiger Hill
stops.tips: A leaning pagoda and the tomb of the King of Wu; return train at 18:00.

backups.name: Shantang Street
backups.tips: A canal street; instead of Tiger Hill.

stops.name: Jing'an Temple
stops.tips: A gold-roofed temple among skyscrapers; in Jing'an.

stops.name: Jing'an Kerry Centre
stops.tips: A shopping centre; souvenirs and coffee.

stops.name: Xiaoyang Shengjian Jing'an
stops.tips: Shengjianbao (pan-fried soup dumplings); your farewell lunch.

stops.name: Maglev Longyang Road
stops.tips: The maglev reaches Pudong Airport in 8 minutes at 430 km/h; a fitting farewell.

backups.name: Jing'an Sculpture Park
backups.tips: A sculpture park and the Natural History Museum.
